profile_text.body:
Saltillo develops TouchChat, an iOS app for augmentative and alternative communication. The company's site describes it as a dynamic communication solution for people who have difficulty speaking with their natural voice, offering customizable features and a range of vocabularies, languages, and voices. The site highlights head tracking, which uses facial recognition on newer iPad Pro and iPhone models to track head and face movements, along with built-in switch scanning and touch access. It also notes iOS Split View, which lets users run two apps side by side. Saltillo offers three different TouchChat apps for download from the App Store.

The site's front page also carries service notices: scheduled maintenance on June 4 from 9:30-10:00 PM ET, and a notice that phone numbers starting with "800" are down, with local numbers starting in "330" given instead (main 330-262-1984, service 330-262-0845).

TouchChat is tracked as an education and research AI product, with word prediction and use as an AAC app for students with communication needs and speech-language pathologists. Its price is listed as TouchChat HD $149.99+ on the App Store, drawn from a state AT program list dated 2022, so that figure may be out of date. The product's privacy practices have not been verified. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded.
